title: The Compassion of the Lord

questions.question: Come, everyone who thirsts, come to the waters; and he who has no money, come, buy and what?
Why do you spend your money for that which is not bread, and your labor for that which does not what?
questions.explanation: Isaiah 55:2 (ESV): "and your labor for that which does not satisfy?"

questions.question: Incline your ear, and come to me; hear, that your soul may live; and I will make with you an everlasting what?
questions.explanation: Isaiah 55:3 (ESV): "and I will make with you an everlasting covenant,"

questions.question: Seek the LORD while he may be found; call upon him while he is what?
questions.explanation: Isaiah 55:6 (ESV): "call upon him while he is near;"

questions.question: Let the wicked forsake his way, and the unrighteous man his what?
questions.explanation: Isaiah 55:7 (ESV): "and the unrighteous man his thoughts;"

questions.question: For my thoughts are not your thoughts, neither are your ways my ways, declares the whom?
For as the heavens are higher than the earth, so are my ways higher than your ways and my thoughts than your what?
questions.explanation: Isaiah 55:9 (ESV): "and my thoughts than your thoughts."

questions.question: For as the rain and the snow come down from heaven and do not return there but water the earth, making it bring forth and sprout, giving seed to the sower and bread to the whom?
So shall my word be that goes out from my mouth; it shall not return to me empty, but it shall accomplish that which I what?
For you shall go out in joy and be led forth in peace; the mountains and the hills before you shall break forth into singing, and all the trees of the field shall clap their what?
Behold, I made him a witness to the peoples, a leader and commander for the whom?
questions.explanation: Isaiah 55:4 (ESV): "a leader and commander for the peoples."

questions.question: Behold, you shall call a nation that you do not know, and a nation that did not know you shall run to you, because of the LORD your God, and of the Holy One of whom?
questions.explanation: Isaiah 55:5 (ESV): "and of the Holy One of Israel,"

questions.question: Let him return to the LORD, that he may have compassion on him, and to our God, for he will abundantly what?
And succeed in the thing for which I sent what?
questions.explanation: Isaiah 55:11 (ESV): "and succeed in the thing for which I sent it."

questions.question: Instead of the thorn shall come up the cypress; instead of the brier shall come up the what?
questions.explanation: Isaiah 55:13 (ESV): "instead of the brier shall come up the myrtle;"

key_verse_text: Seek the LORD while he may be found; call upon him while he is near.
